subject: [PATCH v3 08/18] selftests/mm: add folio-order detection self-check

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify the accuracy of the vm_util folio-order detection helpers, which are used by khugepaged mTHP tests to detect collapse results. The test faults in memory for each supported anon THP order and checks that the helpers report exactly that order, ensuring they agree with the kernel's idea of the backing. This patch also moves the ALIGN() macro into vm_util.h and removes a duplicate copy in hmm-tests.c.
